theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_mb_mass_dichotomy
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → (∀ w : Euclid P, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball w ε) ≠ 0) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) ≤ μ (ball w ρ)) → μ univ = 0 ∨ μ univ = ∞
